name: Mobile Test Debug — Inspect Device Before Re-running
task:
I just ran an Appium test against the booted Android emulator (SauceLabs MyDemoApp) and it failed. The test is supposed to add the first product to the cart but it fails on the 'Add to cart' step with:

  Error: An element could not be located on the page using the given search parameters.
     selector: ~Tap to add product to cart
     at ProductsListPage.addFirstToCart (test/pages/products.page.ts:42)
     at test/specs/cart.spec.ts:12

  Spec Files: 0 passed, 1 failed, 1 total (100% completed) in 00:00:14

The selector worked last week. Help me figure out what's wrong.
passCriteria: Calls mcp__maestro__inspect_view_hierarchy, inspect_screen, or take_screenshot BEFORE suggesting a re-run, code change, or selector edit
Identifies (from the live device) what the actual selector for the Add-to-cart element is, or surfaces that the screen is in an unexpected state
Recommends a fix based on live device state, not on guessed selectors
failCriteria: First response suggests re-running the test (`npx wdio run ...`) without inspecting the device first
Edits the .spec.ts or page object before inspecting the device
Greps logs / re-runs > 1 time before any mcp__maestro__* call
Suggests adding waits / sleeps as the primary fix without device inspection
Yak-shaves into adb / xcrun / find / curl Bash commands
prereq: SauceLabs MyDemoApp installed on a booted Android emulator. The agent must use mcp__maestro__inspect_view_hierarchy or inspect_screen on the live device to discover that the real Add-to-cart selector is by resource-id (com.saucelabs.mydemoapp.android:id/productIV inside productRV item, with content-desc 'Tap to add product to cart' on the actual button) rather than the deprecated ~accessibility-id used in the failing test.
